content: From the beginning, I wanted FeedLand to make excellent use of WebSockets. It's an amazing technology for its power and simplicity. Basically it allows a server running in the cloud send information to an app running in the browser, or for that matter an iOS app running on an iPad. Then the question is what do you want to use the socket for? And the answer is that to make syndication even simpler than RSS, even though as we know it's really simple. Heh. Sorry. But it really is that big a deal. Now if you want to know more, there's a client toolkit and demo app on GitHub, open source of course. How real is it? The blogroll on scripting.com is a sockets app, a much-improved blogroll from the ones we had 20 years ago. Also runs on WordPress sites. It's been running smoothly since March 2024. Pretty solid.
